name: Happiness Inc.
source:
Inspired by Shark Tank, this short romcom visual novel lets you present yourself and answer your prospect client's questions to convince him to marry you. Good luck, and show off your flirting skills in a business manner.

[From [url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/happiness-inc]itch.io[/url]]
